transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening after my surgery?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to keep it light at first.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the information. I was also wondering, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide some more.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks, that's helpful to know. I've also noticed that I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal as the eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s mild, wearing sunglasses outside should help. But if it is severe, or your eye is red and painful as well, that is not normal and may need checking.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, I'll keep an eye on it. My last question is, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be fully clear in the first week after surgery. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting more blurry, we may need to check it.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all I wanted to know. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thanks again for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating, "A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal as the eye adjusts to the new lens." It also conveyed `mild_case_advice` with, "If it’s mild, wearing sunglasses outside should help." Finally, `escalation_criteria` was covered by, "But if it is severe, or your eye is red and painful as well, that is not normal and may need checking." All points were covered in the same turn.
